definitions.attribution: Shapley value over the four stage outputs; residual = chart DDF with all four held at baseline minus baseline
definitions.chart_ddf: rows[i].ddf.blended.value = equal-weight mean of the included, visible charts' Adjusted values (value_reference.py DDF_FAMILY, _rows, _ddf)

engine: pipelines/value_reference.py (Python reference); totals cross-checked on value-model.js
limitations: Pinned engine SHA 430791c4: each projection source's waiver line is one player (work[n_rost]). The seven-player waiver-line average Jeremy approved (pick A, JEG-1244 / #1077) is not on main at this SHA; nothing here measures or implements it.
Week view and prior week are off (no history): every source is priced on its current fixture values, as Setting.result() does without a History.
Default league only (1 QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, 1 TE, 1 FLEX, 7 bench, no superflex), default lineup parameters, default value basis and no DDF input selection.
Attribution runs on the Python reference; the JS engine reproduces totals (js_cross_check), not the stage split, because it has no hook.

Perturbations are synthetic (+-1 PPG to one player, a zero-listed player made absent, a projection-only player removed). They show where coupling exists and how large it is per PPG; they are not a forecast of weekly movement.
